dragon_whelp.description: A young dragon that boosts your combat prowess.
dragon_whelp.source: King Black Dragon raid (1/100 per kill)

imp_pet.description: A mischievous imp that enhances your prayer training.

baby_kraken.description: A tiny kraken that improves your cooking abilities.

rock_golem.description: A living rock formation that enhances your mining prowess.

ent.description: An ancient tree spirit that aids your woodcutting.

tiny_templar.description: A small fish that boosts your fishing expertise.

tangleroot.description: A magical plant creature that enhances your farming.

baby_balrog.description: A tiny demon of fire and shadow that enhances your magic.

void_wisp.description: A fragment of the Void Sovereign's essence, bound to those who bested its master. Amplifies combat experience.

graceling_sprite.description: A nimble fairy born from thousands of laps run in silence. Guides your feet with uncanny grace.

shadow_fox.description: A cunning fox that materialised from the shadows of a thousand pickpocket attempts.

ember_moth.description: Drawn to flame for so long it became one. Its wings shimmer with residual heat.

herb_wisp.description: A spirit born from the vapour of a thousand brewed potions. Its presence sharpens the mind.

rune_sprite.description: A crystallised fragment of magical energy that escaped the Runecrafting altar.

gem_golem.description: A tiny creature sculpted from gem shards and polishing dust. Keeps your tools sharp.

feather_drake.description: A miniature dragon made entirely of arrow fletching. Surprisingly aerodynamic.

forge_imp.description: A mischievous imp that lives inside the forge. Its heat-hardened hide is impervious to burns.

coin_drake.description: A dragon hatchling raised on a diet of gold coins. It has an uncanny nose for profit.

timber_sprite.description: A wood spirit awakened from sawdust and lumber. It knows exactly where every nail should go.

juggling_imp.description: A mischievous imp that juggles your worries away. Boosts all skill XP by 3%.

tower_pet.description: An ancient stone golem that guards the tower's secrets. Boosts combat XP.

solstice_sprite.description: A tiny ember spirit from the Sunspire Solstice event that boosts your combat prowess.
solstice_sprite.source: Sol Invictus raid (1/333 per kill during the Summer Solstice event)

lantern_wisp.description: A grinning gourd-light that escaped the Hollow King's crown and now lights your way to battle.

grave_sprout.description: A stubborn little seedling that took root in a barrow mound. It knows a thing or two about growing.

golden_goose.description: A regal goose that roosts atop the gilded Monument. Coins simply seem to find its keeper.
